connect_feishu_adapter: connect the Feishu/Lark bot adapter using websocket or webhook transport mode
send_text_message: send a formatted text or markdown post message to a Feishu chat with optional reply-to reference
send_exec_approval_card: send an interactive card with approve/deny buttons for dangerous command approval workflows
send_image_file: send a local image file to Feishu by uploading via the image API and sending with optional caption
send_document_file: send a document or file attachment to Feishu with automatic file-type routing for pdf docx xls pptx
normalize_feishu_message: normalize a raw Feishu inbound message into structured text content image keys and media references
parse_feishu_post_payload: parse a Feishu rich-text post payload extracting title content rows image keys and mentioned user ids
handle_webhook_request: handle an incoming Feishu webhook event with rate limiting signature verification and token validation
register_feishu_bot_qr: register a new Feishu or Lark bot application via QR scan device-code flow returning app credentials
